Case 1: Last digit is 0.  
First digit: 5 choices from {1,2,3,4,5}; second: 4 choices; third: 3 choices.  
Count: \(5 \times 4 \times 3 = 60\).

Case 2: Last digit is 2 or 4.  
Last digit: 2 choices. First digit: 4 nonzero choices; second: 4 choices; third: 3 choices.  
Count: \(2 \times 4 \times 4 \times 3 = 96\).

Total: \(60 + 96 = 156\).

\boxed{156}
